map.机动中总载荷因数 n≈√(1+(a/g)²)（平飞转弯时水平向心分量叠加重力），: In a manoeuvre the total load factor n≈√(1+(a/g)²) (in a level turn the horizontal centripetal component adds to gravity), with a small-angle approximation n≈1+a/g. This tool computes the pure centripetal component a, to be used together with the bank-angle and load-factor tools.
